input: Join /data/orders.csv and /data/products.csv on product_id. For each category, compute the total revenue (quantity * price). Print 'category: total_revenue' sorted by revenue descending.

tool_calls:
python - <<'PY'
import csv
PY
ls -l /data && head /data/orders.csv && head /data/products.csv

awk -F, 'FNR==NR { if (FNR>1) { category[$1]=$3; price[$1]=$4 } next } FNR>1 { revenue[category[$2]] += $3 * price[$2] } END { for (c in revenue) print c ": " revenue[c] }' /data/products.csv /data/orders.csv | sort -t ' ' -k2,2nr
